g.text: EDIT-15D · Filters picker / recipe recovery · proposed synthetic planning evidence
Same working-photo anchor in every state · no Samsung assets · not measured Compose, Android or S24+ output
Focus 1 Back → 2 working photo → 3 grid → 4 Cancel
System top/bottom insets reserved; picker never replaces working-photo context.
No photos available for a reference filter.
Cancel/back: no pixels, recipe or Undo position change.
Focus returns to From photo; ≥48 dp logical action target.
Grid scrolls; photo anchor and selected reference stay reachable.
Announce position/count; selected tile uses held sphere, never lapis outline.
Reference selection cancelled. Filter and strength unchanged.
No recipe operation; no Undo entry. Focus → From photo.
IME, if present, dismisses before panel exit; stage re-fits above it.
Keyboard traversal resumes at Filters overflow; system insets stay clear.
That photo could not be decoded. Your edit is unchanged.
Decode failure adds no LUT, recipe step or Undo entry.
Action target ≥48 dp; Back safely returns to unchanged Filters.
Paste disabled until clipboard has a compatible Atlas tone/filter recipe.
Copy changes clipboard only. Paste preview commits one Undo step on Apply.
Focus: overflow → Copy → Paste → dismiss; no new Save path.
